notes.title: Update 1.5 | Food System, Achievements, and More!
notes.content:
Food System 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/dadb24b7e75576dd27f4acfacbd9df18fb2368a0.png

 Introduced a food system where hiders gradually lose food over time.
Penalty is minimal with fewer players, but more challenging with larger groups as food is shared among all players. 
Achievements

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/f01c747354d089562056eff4b294833ccc6b206e.png

Gameplay Enhancements 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/4e5fda61c168e4668b0ec9b528e1ebb3b5e5ed2d.png


 Implemented a system where the game starts only when all players gather at a designated spot.
 The text changes to "Game Starting Soon" once all players are on the spot, followed by a seamless transition into gameplay after a few seconds.

New Tutorial Images 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/c7a45dcff09d31c48200789f8c8424ba6edb5971.png

 Updated tutorial images for clearer and simplified explanations.

Main Menu UI: 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/454518056d661249d2a5b2d5e8c6aa271a9f2ead.png

 Redesigned the main menu UI for improved clarity and aesthetics.
 Added new buttons and repositioned icons for better usability.
 Introduced tips section at the bottom of the screen for player guidance.
 Added a dedicated button for quick access to Discord
 Updated and enhanced the credits page for better readability and completeness.

In-Game UI Improvements 

 Commands are now displayed before the start of each match to help players learn them easily.
Command prompts disappear once the game begins for a cleaner interface. 
 Reduced unnecessary text clutter and introduced icons for clearer communication

notes.title: Update v.03 | November 21, 2023
notes.content:
First and foremost, I'd like to express my gratitude for your ongoing support and share my plans for the future of the game. Moving forward, I plan to release major updates every 7 days. I'll address bugs as quickly as possible because I don't want anyone to struggle while playing. Therefore, I kindly ask you to join the Discord server and report any bugs you encounter. Major updates will include new skins, additions, spells for both classes, entirely new features, and more. I plan to release at least one new pistol skin every week. I'm actively seeking out streamers and YouTubers who would be interested in capturing gameplay for the new trailer. In exchange, they would, of course, receive the game for free. If you happen to be one of them, feel free to contact me via email at contact@gamebesh.com


New map: Backyard

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/b46c44d77472ad39b54b8f3943154baaf9dfdbbc.png
This is an outdoor map featuring new props

New Pistol Skin: Pepica
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44734200/03bce4fb16bb2bfa6eba68c3d5c82df2411bcdd4.png
Type /pepica in the chat, and you'll receive this limited-time-only skin completely free of charge.

Patch Notes:
 Positional Voice Chat (push to talk; 'V' button) - still tweaking settings, expect improved results in v.04
 Updated the primary logo with a Christmas/New Year theme
 Implemented additional spawn points to ensure players don't spawn on top of each other
 Added more new props for the new map
 Snow effect, added for the Backyard map
 Fixed a few glitches caused by player camera collisions

And a few more bug fixes that I forgot to note down... :)
